(isothipendyl) Profile Isothipendyl hydrochloride, an azaphenothiazine derivative, is an antihistamine (p.561) that has been applied topically for hy- persensitivity and pruritic skin disorders although as with any an- tihistamine there is a risk of sensitisation. It has also been given orally and by the rectal route.
